About This Auction

Small Recreational Tract with Build Sites This property is situated on the outskirts of Niotaze, KS. With its prime location and abundant features, this parcel has a lot to offer for it's smaller size. This property combines the tranquility of rural living with the convenience of nearby amenities. Accessible via multiple routes and just a quarter-mile from Hwy 166, commuting and exploration are effortless. If you envision a secluded cabin tucked away in the woods, this property offers numerous build sites to bring your vision to life. For outdoor enthusiasts and hunters alike, this property has a lot going for it. Surrounded by large blocks of mature timber, the grounds are teeming with wildlife, evidenced by the abundance of deer sign throughout. With careful planning, the property's diverse terrain offers the potential for prime hunting opportunities year-round. From the towering trees to the tranquil swamp areas, each feature adds to the property's allure. There is the possibility of creating a duck hole within the small swamp area, adding another dimension to your outdoor pursuits. Don't miss your chance to own this property in Niotaze, KS. Schedule a showing today to see this place in person.   Prime Location Hunting Build Sites Mature Timber Utilities Along the Road
